title: Paying the Rest of the Year's Pre-K Tuition in Advance
content:
## Terms

A family may pay the rest of the school year's Pre-K tuition in advance in one payment, which the parent or guardian makes personally in the district's online payment portal (district staff never take card or bank details), on the board-approved advance-payment schedule. Pre-K tuition here is the tuition billed under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions.

Tuition is paid by the methods the type accepts and is applied to the enrollment's oldest open charge first, and a payment never moves to a sibling's enrollment; an advance payment under the advance-payment schedule is made only in the district's online payment portal, which takes online card and ACH bank draft payments, a first installment under the payment-plan schedule is likewise made only in that portal, and every other tuition payment may still be made by personal check or money order at the campus cashier.

The months the advance covers post on their usual dates and are paid from it, and any credit one of those months later receives stays on the account as a credit balance, refunded under the refund rule.

The advance payment is not fixed until the late fee owed for the enrollment's most recent billing month, when that month's tuition was left unpaid after its due day, has been assessed. The advance payment is fixed only after the combined-program credit owed on the most recent billing month has been worked out and posted for a child who attends Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days).

## Making the payment: `pay_prek_tuition_in_advance_058a705f`

**Capability.** The portal takes the advance payment and books one tuition payment entry on the enrollment, dated today. The payment lowers the amount the household owes, and any amount beyond the open charges stands as a credit for the months it covers. The parent receives a payment confirmation number.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The support agent unlocks `pay_prek_tuition_in_advance_058a705f` and hands it over; the parent or guardian, the customer themselves, runs it and enters the payment details in the portal.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `enrollment_id` | the reference number of the student's Pre-K enrollment record for the school year, as given by the support agent from the enrollment lookup | text id |
| `amount` | the advance payment amount quoted by the support agent | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; the portal rounds half up to the cent |
| `payment_method` | how the parent pays | exactly one of: `online_card` (a debit or credit card entered in the portal); `ach_bank_draft` (a checking or savings account by bank draft entered in the portal); `personal_check` (a paper check, taken only at the campus cashier, so the portal refuses it); `money_order` (taken only at the campus cashier, so the portal refuses it); `not_applicable` (no payment method, which the portal refuses) |

**Return.** On success, a one-line receipt beginning "Advance payment received:" gives the payment confirmation number (eight digits), the new ledger entry reference, the enrollment reference, the amount paid (USD, two decimals), the payment method and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt beginning "Error:" means no payment was taken because an argument did not meet its format: a payment method other than `online_card` or `ach_bank_draft`, or an amount that is not positive.
